verdict.rationale: The evidence documents real-time sync, WebSocket transport and client-side state management for live updates. None of it mentions offline persistence, locally queued writes, or automatic replay of writes on reconnect. One community comment contrasts Convex with Firestore, saying Firestore syncs data to the device and gets better offline behavior, which suggests Convex does not offer this. Live-update sync is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for offline-first writes.
